The '''''Nebula II''''' was a [[Warship/Legends|warship]] in the [[Republic Navy/Legends|Republic Navy]].

==History==
It participated in the [[Battle of Koros Major]] in the lead-up to the [[Great Sith War/Legends|Great Sith War]].

During the battle, [[Fleet Captain/Legends|Fleet Captain]] [[Vanicus]] ordered the ''Nebula II'' to come around to point 6 and take out the [[Krath command station]]'s aft [[Turbolaser/Legends|turbolaser]] array.
